t: The $(5)Glow Module$() can be used in a $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() to illuminate the area around the field. Installing $(5)Glow Modules$() into a Projector makes the force field emit light. As more $(5)Glow Modules$() are added (up to a maximum of 64), the field's brightness increases - until it becomes equal to that of Glowstone.
$(5)发光模块$()可用于$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()，以照亮力场周边区域。在投射器中安装$(5)发光模块$()，可使力场自身发出光源。随着添加的$(5)发光模块$()数量增多（最多可达64个），力场亮度将逐步提升——直至达到荧光石的亮度水平。
A Force Field Projector projecting a field with $(5)Glow Module$()s installed.
一个力场投影仪正在投射力场，且已安装$(5)发光模块$()。
